hints.title: Single-Digit Greedy Factorization
hints.text: To minimize the integer whose digits multiply to num, maximize larger single-digit factors at lower place values.

hints.title: Descending Factor Division
hints.text: Extract factor d from 9 down to 2 while num is divisible by d. Smaller single-digit factors earlier produce longer numbers.

hints.title: 32-Bit Overflow Verification
hints.text: If num < 2, return num. Repeatedly divide by d from 9 down to 2 and prepend digits. If num > 1 after checking all digits up to 2, or if result exceeds 2^31 - 1, return 0.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Greedy factorization with at most 32 digits.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through candidate integers sequentially from 1 upwards times out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Greedy division from 9 down to 2 constructs minimal decimal representation directly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Divide greedily by largest digit factors 9 down to 2 and check 32-bit limits.
